parameters.description: The start URL: a public `http` or `https` URL. The crawl starts on this exact URL and stays on its domain, subdomains included.
parameters.name: url

parameters.description: How many link steps to follow from the start URL. At `1`, the links on the start page. Omit it to follow links until `max_items` or `max_pages` stops the crawl.
parameters.name: depth

parameters.description: Stop after keeping this many URLs.
parameters.name: max_items

parameters.description: Stop after fetching this many pages. Caps what the crawl costs. If both limits are reached together, `stop_reason` is `max_pages`.
parameters.name: max_pages

parameters.description: Keep, and open, only URLs that contain at least one of these texts, such as `/product/`. The start URL is never returned.
parameters.name: include_patterns

schema.description: Keep, and open, only URLs that contain at least one of these texts, such as `/product/`. The start URL is never returned.

parameters.description: Drop URLs that contain any of these texts, even when they match an include pattern.

description: Fetch public webpages and check your ZenRows plan usage.

zenrows_crawl_completed_trigger.description: Runs each time a crawl is completed in ZenRows. Ones completed before the workflow is turned on don't start it. It can watch up to 4,000. How often it checks follows your workspace plan.

output.record: object with the fields crawl_id, status, stop_reason, error.code, error.detail, url, depth, max_items, max_pages, include_patterns, exclude_patterns, output_format, discovery, coverage.pages_fetched, coverage.pages_failed, coverage.items_found, duplicates_removed, created_at, finished_at

zenrows_crawl_failed_trigger.description: Runs each time a crawl is failed in ZenRows. Ones failed before the workflow is turned on don't start it. It can watch up to 4,000. How often it checks follows your workspace plan.
